proof_obligations.PO-CONDITIONING: Condition low frames, source outcomes and original low-ell-only selection, not full alpha/delta labels, for source moments. An output-curvature selector reads delta mod3 and does not satisfy this premise. Mutual information conditions full public labels and then averages over their source distribution. Do not interchange these statements.
proof_obligations.PO-MOMENT: For every nonzero secret including divisible secrets, effective order is at least3. Independent alpha/delta enforce equality of the two physical-trit multisets in each fourth moment, also at effective order3. Fixed low carries then cancel exactly.
proof_obligations.PO-GEOMETRY: The actual selected physical frame is injective. Full symmetric-square direction rank separates unordered word pairs by sums and outer products, giving energy2D^2-D. Rank failure is not proof failure of every decoder; use a bounded pair census or retain missing status.
proof_obligations.PO-ENTROPY: Exact mean local Fourier collision is E/D^3. Shannon versus collision entropy and Jensen give a source-mean information bound log(E/D^2)+(log(D)-log(E/D^2))/q^n, with zero-secret correction retained.
proof_obligations.PO-SAMPLES: Fixed product measurements factor conditional on secret and labels. Entropy subadditivity and Fano impose a total-information sample requirement, even for unlimited classical decoding. This is not an inference-time lower bound.
proof_obligations.PO-NUMERICS: Large-root zero mass is retained exactly as a rational. Floating entropy and Fano values are estimates, not certified numerical intervals or an exact proof from finite samples.
proof_obligations.PO-SCOPE: The bound is source-mean, uniform-prior and specific to fixed local Fourier bases. It excludes label/outcome-adaptive bases and coherent nonproduct measurements. Classical simulation and quantum hardness are not proved.
proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Physical IID supply, correlated channel error, independent mathematical review, novelty comparison and a tractable full-secret inference algorithm remain unresolved.

falsifiable_experiments: A physical code with the certified square rank has an extra unordered-pair collision.
True original alpha/delta chart mutations change low acquisition supports or violate the exact fourth moment.
A divisible nonzero secret is incorrectly treated as an exception to the effective-order argument.
A pointwise, adaptive-measurement, collective or computational-hardness claim is inferred from this source-mean entropy bound.
